articles.title: Global Market: Hong Kong sets pricing guidance for four-year digital green bond
articles.excerpt:
The Hong Kong government is set to launch a significant four-year euro-denominated green bond in a digital format. With its initial pricing guidance of 11 basis points above mid-swaps, the settlement is scheduled for Tuesday. The funds raised will support eco-friendly projects within the scope of Hong Kong's Green Bond Framework. This initiative also signifies an increasing shift towards digital bond issuance in the financial sector.

articles.title: Oil woes push rupee to over one-week low, RBI caps fall near 96/USD
articles.excerpt:
On Monday, the Indian rupee plummeted to its lowest mark in over a week, driven by soaring oil prices. Investors reacted to mounting geopolitical tensions, leading to an uptick in bond yields and a dip in stock values within the region. State-run banks intervened by selling dollars, likely under the guidance of the Reserve Bank of India, which helped to mitigate further declines in the currency's value.
